name: folio-site-assets
description: Not built with npm: assets/fuse.min.js is a copy of Fuse.js. This file and package-lock.json name that version so that the vulnerability scan (.github/workflows/vulncheck.yml) sees it. Change the version here, run `npm install --package-lock-only`, and replace the file in assets/ together; fuse_test.go checks that they match.
